_comment: Sample (non-proprietary) manufacturing overlay spec. Point MANUFACTURING_OVERLAY_SPEC at a copy of this (or mount it as a K8s secret) to add extraction fields without committing them to the repo. Each field declares how it is extracted (description) AND how it is persisted (neo4j_attr / related / rdf_literal / rdf_relation).

fields.name: lot_acceptance_code
fields.description: The Lot Acceptance Code (LAC) governing this step, e.g. 'LAC-7731'. Null if not mentioned.

fields.name: torque_spec_nm
fields.description: Torque specification in newton-metres (Nm) called out in this step, as an integer. Null if not mentioned.

fields.name: special_processes
fields.description: Named special processes invoked by this step (e.g. heat-treat or plating codes). Empty list if none.
